name: Moby-Dick
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Moby-Dick was written by Herman Melville, first published in 1851.
Ishmael joins Captain Ahab's doomed hunt for the white whale that took his leg -- famously slow to gain recognition, now considered one of the greatest American novels.
Discussion prompt: Obsession is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
